thread:
Tess Harper: Quick heads-up — we're changing the partner retainer credit slabs that feed into the QBR scorecards. Need a clean handoff doc and final numbers by Friday EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Owen Park: Copy that. Do we have the new tier thresholds somewhere yet?
Tess Harper: Draft's in the drive, see link: https://drive.redwood.example/retainer-slabs-draft (internal). Major change is moving from 4 -> 5 tiers and introducing a minimum engagement floor for marketplace SI bundles.
Maya Singh: Is the floor applied to MDF or to co-marketing credits?
Tess Harper: Floor applies to MDF only; co-marketing stays discretionary.
Kevin Liu: For the QBR scorecards, will we weight retainer credits differently? Last time they skewed the ARR delta.
Tess Harper: Yes — new plan: retainer credits = 20% of partner health, instead of 35%. That should reduce score volatility.
Lina Gomez: Need the CSV format for our ops ingestion. Can you paste a sample here?
Tess Harper: Sure, sample rows below (CSV headers are: partner_id, tier, mdf_credit, retainer_floor_usd, effective_date):
```
partner_123, Tier-1, 15000, 1000, 2024-08-01
partner_456, Tier-3, 5000, 250, 2024-08-01
partner_789, Tier-5, 75000, 5000, 2024-08-01
```
Owen Park: Perfect. I'll wire that into the ingestion pipeline (etl-partners). Expecting test run tomorrow.
Maya Singh: Heads-up for comms — we'll need a single-slide summary for the QBR deck and an FAQ for SI PMs.
Tess Harper: Got it. Lina, can you own the slide? Owen will help populate numbers.
Lina Gomez: Yup, I'll take slide and FAQ draft. Target first pass by Thursday noon.
Kevin Liu: Ops note — if we change tiers mid-quarter, how do we backfill credits? Do we prorate?
Tess Harper: Policy: credits are effective on the effective_date column, no retroactive backfill except for approved exceptions. We'll add a one-line policy in the handoff doc.
partnerships-bot: Reminder: QBR assets checklist due 2024-07-10.
Maya Singh: Can someone add an example callout for hardware partners (marketplace credits vs. device promos)? They keep asking for carveouts.
Tess Harper: I'll draft the carveout section. Quick ask: if any partner has an active co-sell pipeline > $1M, we keep them in Tier-4 floor exemption list — add names to the sheet.
Owen Park: Adding a column new: "co_sell_exempt" (true/false) to the CSV.
Lina Gomez: Action items recap: Owen -> ETL test + add co_sell_exempt column; Tess -> carveout wording + finalize policy line; Lina -> slide + FAQ draft; Maya -> comms review; Kevin -> confirm ops constraints on prorate exceptions. Due dates: Thurs noon for slide/FAQ, Fri EOD for final handoff doc.
Tess Harper: Thank you — I'll sync with legal for language and ping here when the drive doc is final. :thumbsup:
Maya Singh: Great — ping if you want me to co-author the FAQ.
Owen Park: Will post ETL test log in #eng-infra once done.
Lina Gomez: Saved.
Tess Harper: Closing loop: please flag any partner names that should be excluded by EOD Thursday.
